routing.selection: explicit CoreAudio output UID; read-only inventory
routing.physicalChannels: requires at least2; physical conversion/layout unqualified

startup.timeline: real AudioQueueCreateTimeline; nonnull timeline passed to GetCurrentTime
startup.readiness: valid queue-relative sample and host fields; stable initial anchor published atomically
startup.arm: explicit control atomic; binds scheduler clock before first render
startup.errorCleanup: explicit shutdown reports original setup plus any cleanup error

callback.state: UnsafeCell Data under entered atomic guard before any mutable PCM/Data borrow, including same-buffer overlap
callback.failure: submit silent buffers until control poll stops queue; no immediate acoustic mute guarantee for previously queued audio

lifetime.controlThread: Output is !Send/!Sync; start/arm/poll/stop/drop on creator thread
lifetime.watchdog: regular poll observes both callback count and hardware-frame progress; hardware clock freeze times out despite busy callbacks
lifetime.device: selected UID availability, physical channel count and nominal rate checked on control thread
lifetime.disposal: always attempts Dispose(true) after Stop(true), including stop failure; only then release callback state
lifetime.failedDisposal: retain state to prevent UAF; explicit error and retained report; no successful-release claim
lifetime.helperCleanup: queue fault cancels cue status; Session.poll separately stops/reaps helpers while dry files continue

adapterCases: silent startup and clock readiness before arm
512 wet frames scheduled exactly after primed queue lead; normal stop/dispose
timeline discontinuity, missing host flags, backward time, excess output drift and clock-query failure silence
no callbacks and busy callbacks with frozen clock both timeout
advancing hardware frames reset watchdog; device loss stops/disposes
stop error still disposes; dispose error retains readable state and prohibits rearm
setup before queue creation performs no stop/dispose
setup error reports original plus stop/dispose failure and retains uncertain state
same PCM pointer overlapping callback returns before mutable borrow
stop inside clock query suppresses spurious error and reenqueue
read-only output inventory and invalid UID preflight without queue creation

nativeHelperComposition.chain: generated128-frame capture to real native cue worker; actual output callback with fake timeline triggers scheduler underrun; Session.poll closes helpers; two more128-frame dry blocks persist

tests.portableBind: new queue anchor binds before first render; rebind after rendering and startup-clock overflow rejected without retiming
tests.sdkAbi: ASBD/Buffer/Timestamp layouts/constants plus NewOutput/CreateTimeline/GetCurrentTime function signatures syntax-checked with selected Mac SDK

qualificationLimits: Actual AudioQueueNewOutput/Start/device conversion are not exercised by fake operations
No real sample/host anchor, acoustic playback/round-trip latency or physical hot-plug qualification
No sustained-load/deadline benchmark; tests wait off callback for generated helper data
No shared cue/backing mixer or input/backing/project mapping/persisted clip placement
No drift resampling/correction or independent-device synchronization guarantee
No new app recording commands/UI/project insertion/Undo integration
A failed disposal intentionally retains memory and does not prove OS resources released
